page.overview:
Who is Alan Kobayashi?

Alan Kobayashi belongs to Star Trek. Captain Alan Kobayashi was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, he was the commander of the. On stardate 41375.3, he received an order about fiscal cutbacks from Admiral Gerald Kawaoki of Starfleet Mission Operations Unit.

The captain was requested to send acknowledgement of the receipt of this order through subspace com net security mode 045, code 100 alpha.
